family: GTK2 GtkEntry mapped X11 focus and active role

implementation_change.change: The probe now moves the X server's input focus to the mapped GtkWindow with xdotool, verifies the focused XID and GtkWindow.has-toplevel-focus, then measures focused-role pixels. Gtk.Window.set_focus and GtkWidget.grab_focus alone only change GTK's internal focus child and were insufficient for this proof.

method.toolkit: GTK 2.24.33 real GtkEntry using the DomainOS pixmap recipe
method.temporary_storage: A private mount namespace bind-mounted ~/tempia/i167-xvfb-private-r66 over /tmp inside that namespace; the shared /tmp and other X sessions were not modified.
method.focus_delivery: Mapped host window received xdotool windowfocus --sync; xdotool getwindowfocus matched the GTK XID and GtkWindow.has-toplevel-focus was true. The test runs both separate toplevel and GtkSocket/GtkPlug origins.
method.test_runner: tools/theme-lab/tests/test_gtk2_entry_keyboard_native.py passed; 24 native scenes across four palettes.
method.probe_command: unshare --user --map-root-user --mount --propagation private; bind ~/tempia/i167-xvfb-private-r66 to /tmp; xvfb-run -a -n 700; run probe_gtk2_entry_paint.py

limits: This proves the GTK2 focus event and dynamic focus-role painting on mapped X11 toplevels, not behavior under a desktop window manager.
Historical focus comparison remains limited to R57's saved SR10.4 image; current clone video is still almost entirely black.
Historical selected-text shape/color and caret blink period remain unmeasured. GTK2 caret height/caps retain the R61/R63 limitation.
No product theme was installed and XChat, the user profile, guest, network and other MAME instances were untouched.
next: Continue I167 GTK2 only. Use the now-proven mapped focus path for further Entry state tests; resume direct historical visual comparison only when the correct SR10.4 guest shows VUE.
